purpose: re-adjudication of the four G1.2 FALSE_FACT relations on BOE-A-2012-9058 under the O1/O2/O3 claim split (operation ownership / locator declaration / prior subject existence). Frozen before any G2 runtime change.

cases.operative_clause: 1. En la página 34.687, en el apartado uno de la disposición final primera, donde dice «Circular XX/2019, de xx de xx», debe decir «Circular 2/2019, de 29 de marzo».
cases.owner_evidence: BOE-A-2019-6888 is 'Corrección de errores de la Circular 2/2019' (rango: Corrección (errores o erratas); ELI cir/2019/03/29/2/corrigendum/20190510). Its anteriores list both 'CORRIGE errores ... de la Circular 2/2019' (the corrected instrument) and 'CORRIGE errores en la Circular 5/2012' (downstream secondary relation). The clause cites page 34.687 — a page of the 2/2019 publication — and the corrected text sits inside 2/2019's own disposición final primera. The operation's owner is the corrected instrument; the secondary CORRIGE relation to 5/2012 does not transfer subject ownership.
cases.locator_evidence: The clause does declare 'disposición final primera' — of Circular 2/2019, not of 5/2012. Declaration is true; the locator was attached to the wrong target.
cases.lifecycle_evidence: Not this target's operation. For completeness: 5/2012's original publication carries an unnumbered 'Disposición final. Entrada en vigor.', so 'disp:final.primera' is PROVEN_ABSENT in the target — consistent with the G1 audit.

cases.operative_clause: 2. En la página 34.688, en el apartado cuatro de la disposición final primera, donde dice «Circular XX/2019», debe decir «Circular 2/2019».
cases.owner_evidence: Same corrigendum, second item: corrects apartado cuatro of 2/2019's disposición final primera (page 34.688). The downstream 'CORRIGE errores en la Circular 5/2012' relation does not make 2/2019's own dispositions subjects of 5/2012.
cases.locator_evidence: Clause declares 'disposición final primera' of the corrected instrument.
cases.lifecycle_evidence: Not this target's operation; 'disp:final.primera' is PROVEN_ABSENT in 5/2012 (its disposition is unnumbered).

cases.operative_clause: a) Se modifican las letras c), d), e) y f) del apartado 1.3.2, que quedan redactadas de la siguiente manera:
cases.owner_evidence: Clause sits under 'Cinco. En el anejo 3 «Información precontractual que se debe resaltar ante los clientes», se realizan las siguientes modificaciones' inside 'Norma tercera. Modificación de la Circular 5/2012' of Circular 3/2022 — the operation does belong to the target.
cases.locator_evidence: The clause declares 'apartado 1.3.2, letras c)-f) of anejo 3' — the recorded locator 'norma:11.apartado:1.letra:c' inherits a stale norma context (from item Cuatro's 'norma undécima') and truncates 'apartado 1.3.2' to 'apartado:1'. The declared locator was mis-composed.
cases.lifecycle_evidence: The recorded locator is not the declared one; existence of the *recorded* subject is not the operative question. The declared subject (anejo 3, apartado 1.3.2) exists in the target's structure.
cases.g2_category: E: LOCATOR_PARSER_FAILURE (stale norma context under anejo-scoped clause)

cases.operative_clause: b) Se modifica el apartado 9.2, que queda redactado de la siguiente forma: (sibling: a) Se modifica el primer párrafo del apartado 9.1)
cases.owner_evidence: Clause sits under 'Seis. En el anejo 4, se realizan las siguientes modificaciones' inside 'Norma tercera. Modificación de la Circular 5/2012' — the operation belongs to the target.
cases.locator_evidence: The clause declares 'apartado 9.1 / 9.2 of anejo 4' — the recorded locator 'norma:11.apartado:9' again inherits the stale norma context and truncates the compound apartado numbering. Declared locator mis-composed.
cases.lifecycle_evidence: The declared subject (anejo 4, apartado 9.x) exists in the target's structure; the recorded locator does not resolve.
cases.g2_category: E: LOCATOR_PARSER_FAILURE (stale norma context under anejo-scoped clause)

summary.note: All four G1.2 FALSE_FACTs are genuine runtime defects under the O1/O2/O3 split: two corrigendum-local subjects mis-attributed through a downstream BOE relation, two anejo-scoped locators mis-composed under a stale norma context. Neither is an honest 'subject not in original publication' case.
